{{Top|leg}}
The '''under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense''' was a position within the [[Bureau of Patriotic Defense]], part of the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Under-palatine for the Bureau of Patriotic Defense (Clone Wars)|holder]] of the title participated in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] missions between Troxar and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="YDR 1">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 1.</ref>
